# workbridgepersonal 
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>WorkBrige Personal — Auftragsausführung mit eigenem Team</title>
<meta name="description" content="WorkBrige Personal übernimmt und führt Arbeiten für Unternehmen aus — von Lagerarbeiten bis zur Inbetriebnahme von Produktionslinien. Eigene Teams, faire Bezahlung, zuverlässige Ausführung.">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@700;800;900&family=Work+Sans:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --ink:#12293D;
    --ink-soft:#4A6072;
    --blue:#1E6091;
    --blue-deep:#0F3552;
    --green:#4C9A3D;
    --green-deep:#1F5C2E;
    --paper:#F6F8F7;
    --paper-alt:#EBF1EE;
    --line:#DCE6E2;
    --white:#FFFFFF;
    --radius:14px;
    --ribbon: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--blue) 0%, var(--green) 100%);
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--paper);
    color:var(--ink);
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif;
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  h1,h2,h3,.display{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    font-weight:900;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    line-height:1.05;
    margin:0;
    color:var(--ink);
  }
  .eyebrow{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-weight:500;
    font-size:12.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.14em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;
  }
  .eyebrow::before{
    content:"";
    width:18px;height:2px;
    background:var(--ribbon);
    display:inline-block;
    border-radius:2px;
  }
  p{color:var(--ink-soft); margin:0;}
  a{color:inherit;}
  img,svg{display:block; max-width:100%;}
  .wrap{
    max-width:1180px;
    margin:0 auto;
    padding:0 28px;
  }
  section{padding:96px 0;}
  .placeholder{
    background:#FFF6E0;
    color:#7A5B00;
    padding:0 4px;
    border-radius:3px;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size:0.88em;
  }
  ::selection{background:var(--green); color:#fff;}
  :focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--blue); outline-offset:3px;}

  /* ---------- Header ---------- */
  header{
    position:sticky; top:0; z-index:50;
    background:rgba(246,248,247,0.9);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .nav{
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding:16px 28px;
    max-width:1180px; margin:0 auto;
  }
  .brand{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; text-decoration:none;}
  .brand-word{
    font-family:'Archivo', sans-serif;
    font-weight:900;
    font-size:19px;
    letter-spacing:-0.01em;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .brand-word .b{color:var(--blue);}
  .brand-word .g{color:var(--green);}
  .brand-sub{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;
    font-size:9.5px;
    letter-spacing:0.18em;
    color:var(--ink-soft);
    text-transform:uppercase;
    display:block;
    margin-top:-2px;
  }
  .navlinks{display:flex; gap:30px; list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0;}
  .navlinks a{
    text-decoration:none; color:var(--ink);
    font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500;
    padding-bottom:3px;
    border-bottom:2px solid transparent;
    transition:border-color .2s;
  }
  .navlinks a:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--green);}
  .nav-ctas{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center;}
  .navtoggle{display:none; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; padding:6px;}
  .navtoggle span{display:block; width:22px; height:2px; background:var(--ink); margin:5px 0; border-radius:2px;}
  .langsw{display:flex; gap:2px; background:var(--paper-alt); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:999px; padding:3px; margin-right:4px;}
  .lang-btn{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.04em;
    border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--ink-soft); padding:6px 10px; border-radius:999px;
    cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s, color .15s;
  }
  .lang-btn:hover{color:var(--ink);}
  .lang-btn.active{background:var(--ink); color:#fff;}
  .langsw-mobile{display:flex; gap:8px; margin-top:18px;}
  .langsw-mobile .lang-btn{border:1.5px solid var(--line); flex:1;}

  /* ---------- Glossy apply button (Bewerbungsformular) ---------- */
  .btn-apply{
    position:relative;
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-weight:700; font-size:14px;
    padding:11px 22px;
    border-radius:999px;
    color:#fff;
    text-decoration:none;
    white-space:nowrap;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ff6a5e 0%, #e8261a 42%, #b8140b 100%);
    border:1px solid #7a0a04;
    box-shadow:0 6px 14px -4px rgba(184,20,11,.55), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    overflow:hidden;
    transition:transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
  }
  .btn-apply::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; left:6%; right:6%; top:10%; height:34%;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.75), rgba(255,255,255,0));
    border-radius:999px;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .btn-apply:hover{
    transform:translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow:0 10px 20px -6px rgba(184,20,11,.65), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.4);
  }
  .btn-apply-mobile{width:100%; margin-top:14px; padding:13px 22px; font-size:15px;}

  /* ---------- Bewerbungsformular overlay (embedded application form) ---------- */
  .bewerbung-overlay{
    position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:999;
    background:#fff;
    display:none;
  }
  .bewerbung-overlay.open{display:block;}
  .bewerbung-overlay iframe{width:100%; height:100%; border:none; display:block;}
  .bewerbung-close{
    position:fixed; top:16px; right:16px; z-index:1000;
    width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%;
    background:var(--ink); color:#fff; border:none; cursor:pointer;
    font-size:19px; line-height:1; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 6px 16px -4px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
    transition:background .15s;
  }
  .bewerbung-close:hover{background:var(--blue-deep);}

  /* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
  .btn{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;
    font-family:'Work Sans', sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:14.5px;
    padding:12px 22px; border-radius:999px;
    text-decoration:none; border:1.5px solid transparent;
    cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, background .2s;
  }
  .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);}
  .btn-blue{background:var(--blue); color:#fff;}
  .btn-blue:hover{background:var(--blue-deep); box-shadow:0 8px 20px -8px rgba(30,96,145,.6);}
  .btn-green{background:var(--green); color:#fff;}
  .btn-green:hover{background:var(--green-deep); box-shadow:0 8px 20px -8px rgba(76,154,61,.6);}
  .btn-ghost{background:transparent; border-color:var(--line); color:var(--ink);}
  .btn-ghost:hover{border-color:var(--ink);}
  .btn-sm{padding:9px 16px; font-size:13.5px;}

  /* ---------- Ribbon divider (signature element) ---------- */
  .ribbon-wrap{
    width:100%; overflow:hidden; line-height:0;
    margin:0; background:var(--paper);
  }
  .ribbon-wrap svg{width:100%; height:auto; display:block;}
  .ribbon-path{
    stroke-dasharray:2000;
    stroke-dashoffset:2000;
    animation:draw 1.8s ease forwards;
  }
  @keyframes draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0;}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    .ribbon-path{animation:none; stroke-dashoffset:0;}
    html{scroll-behavior:auto;}
  }

  /* ---------- Hero ---------- */
  .hero{
    position:relative;
    padding:88px 0 0;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero-inner{
    display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.1fr 0.9fr; gap:40px;
    align-items:center;
  }
  .hero h1{
    font-size:clamp(38px, 5.2vw, 64px);
  }
  .hero h1 .grad{
    background:var(--ribbon);
    -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
  }
  .hero p.lead{
    margin-top:22px; font-size:18px; max-width:44ch;
  }
  .hero-ctas{display:flex; gap:14px; margin-top:34px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .hero-nodes{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:56px;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size:12px;
  }
  .node{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;}
  .dot{width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%;}
  .dot-blue{background:var(--blue);}
  .dot-green{background:var(--green);}

  .hero-art{position:relative; height:340px;}
  .hero-art svg{width:100%; height:100%;}

  /* ---------- Section headers ---------- */
  .sec-head{max-width:640px; margin-bottom:52px;}
  .sec-head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,40px); margin-top:12px;}
  .sec-head p{margin-top:14px; font-size:16.5px;}
  .sec-head.center{margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; text-align:center;}

  /* ---------- Services ---------- */
  .services{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr); gap:24px;}
  .card{
    background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:32px 28px; transition:transform .2s, box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s;
  }
  .card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px); box-shadow:0 20px 40px -24px rgba(15,53,82,.35); border-color:transparent;}
  .card-num{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-soft);
    letter-spacing:.1em;
  }
  .card h3{font-size:20px; margin-top:14px;}
  .card p{margin-top:10px; font-size:15px;}
  .card-bar{width:34px; height:4px; border-radius:4px; margin-bottom:18px;}

  .chips{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; margin-top:40px;}
  .chip{
    font-size:13.5px; font-weight:500; padding:9px 16px; border-radius:999px;
    background:var(--paper-alt); border:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink);
  }

  /* ---------- Zielgruppen (dual column) ---------- */
  .dual{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:0; border-radius:20px; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line);}
  .dual-col{padding:48px 40px; background:var(--white);}
  .dual-col.blue{background:linear-gradient(180deg, var(--blue-deep), var(--blue)); color:#fff;}
  .dual-col.green{background:var(--paper);}
  .dual-col h3{font-size:26px;}
  .dual-col.blue h3{color:#fff;}
  .dual-col.green h3{color:var(--green-deep);}
  .dual-col ul{list-style:none; margin:24px 0 0; padding:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px;}
  .dual-col li{display:flex; gap:12px; font-size:15px;}
  .dual-col.blue li{color:#E7F0F7;}
  .dual-col.green li{color:var(--ink-soft);}
  .check{flex:none; width:18px; height:18px; margin-top:2px;}
  .dual-col .btn{margin-top:32px;}

  /* ---------- Process ---------- */
  .process{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:0; position:relative;}
  .step{padding:0 24px 0 0; position:relative;}
  .step:not(:last-child)::after{
    content:""; position:absolute; top:22px; right:-2px; width:calc(100% - 44px); height:2px;
    background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line) 0 6px, transparent 6px 12px);
  }
  .step-num{
    width:44px; height:44px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-weight:500; font-size:14px;
    background:var(--paper-alt); border:1.5px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); position:relative; z-index:1;
  }
  .step h4{font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:17px; margin-top:18px;}
  .step p{margin-top:8px; font-size:14.5px;}

  /* ---------- Stellen ---------- */
  .role-grid{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px; margin-top:36px;}
  .role{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
    background:var(--white); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:12px;
    padding:14px 18px; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500;
  }
  .role .tag{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--white);
    background:var(--ribbon); padding:3px 8px; border-radius:6px; letter-spacing:.05em;
  }
  .role-note{margin-top:22px; font-size:14.5px;}

  /* ---------- About / values ---------- */
  .about{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:60px; align-items:start;}
  .about-copy p{font-size:17px; margin-top:18px;}
  .values{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:28px;}
  .value{display:flex; gap:18px;}
  .value-mark{
    flex:none; width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:10px;
    background:var(--paper-alt); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .value h4{font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:16.5px;}
  .value p{margin-top:6px; font-size:14.5px;}

  /* ---------- Trust strip ---------- */
  .trust{
    background:var(--blue-deep); color:#fff; border-radius:20px;
    padding:44px 40px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:28px;
  }
  .trust-item{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px;}
  .trust-item .k{font-family:'Archivo',sans-serif; font-weight:800; font-size:15px;}
  .trust-item .v{font-size:13.5px; color:#B9CBD9;}

  /* ---------- Contact ---------- */
  .contact-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:0.9fr 1.1fr; gap:56px;}
  .contact-info{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:22px;}
  .info-row{display:flex; gap:14px; font-size:15px;}
  .info-row .label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11px; color:var(--ink-soft); letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; min-width:92px;}
  form{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:16px;}
  .row2{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px;}
  label{font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-bottom:6px; display:block;}
  input, textarea, select{
    width:100%; font-family:'Work Sans',sans-serif; font-size:15px;
    padding:12px 14px; border-radius:10px; border:1.5px solid var(--line);
    background:var(--white); color:var(--ink);
  }
  textarea{min-height:110px; resize:vertical;}
  .audience{display:flex; gap:10px;}
  .audience label{
    flex:1; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:12px; font-weight:600; font-size:14px;
    cursor:pointer; color:var(--ink); margin:0;
  }
  .audience input{width:auto;}
  .form-note{font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-soft); margin-top:4px;}
  #formMsg{display:none; background:var(--paper-alt); border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:10px; padding:14px 16px; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--green-deep); font-weight:600;}

  /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
  footer{background:var(--ink); color:#B7C4CE; padding:56px 0 28px;}
  .foot-grid{display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr; gap:40px;}
  .foot-brand .brand-word .b{color:#7FB4D9;}
  .foot-brand .brand-word .g{color:#8FCB7E;}
  .foot-brand p{color:#8FA0AC; margin-top:14px; font-size:14px; max-width:34ch;}
  .foot-col h5{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-size:11.5px; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#8FA0AC; margin:0 0 16px;}
  .foot-col ul{list-style:none; margin:0; padding:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;}
  .foot-col a{color:#D3DDE4; text-decoration:none; font-size:14px;}
  .foot-col a:hover{color:#fff;}
  .foot-bottom{
    margin-top:48px; padding-top:24px; border-top:1px solid #29404F;
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px;
    font-size:12.5px; color:#7E93A0;
  }
  footer .placeholder{background:#213947; color:#F2C879;}
  .trust-item .placeholder{background:#1B3A50; color:#BFE0F5;}

  /* ---------- Reveal animation ---------- */
  .reveal{opacity:0; transform:translateY(18px); transition:opacity .6s ease, transform .6s ease;}
  .reveal.in{opacity:1; transform:none;}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.reveal{opacity:1; transform:none; transition:none;}}

  /* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
  @media (max-width: 900px){
    .navlinks, .nav-ctas{display:none;}
    .navtoggle{display:block;}
    .hero-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .hero-art{height:220px; margin-top:20px;}
    .services{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .dual{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .process{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; row-gap:36px;}
    .step:nth-child(2)::after{display:none;}
    .about{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .trust{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;}
    .contact-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .row2, .audience{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    section{padding:64px 0;}
  }
  @media (max-width:560px){
    .trust{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .process{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
    .foot-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <nav class="nav">
    <a href="#top" class="brand" aria-label="WorkBridge Personal — Startseite">
      <svg width="36" height="30" viewBox="0 0 36 30" fill="none" aria-hidden="true">
        <circle cx="9" cy="6" r="5" fill="#1E6091"/>
        <circle cx="27" cy="6" r="5" fill="#4C9A3D"/>
        <path d="M2 26 C 2 16, 8 15, 9 15 C 18 15, 18 10, 18 10 C 18 10, 18 15, 27 15 C 28 15, 34 16, 34 26" stroke="url(#g1)" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
        <defs><linearGradient id="g1" x1="0" y1="0" x2="36" y2="0"><stop stop-color="#1E6091"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#4C9A3D"/></linearGradient></defs>
      </svg>
      <span>
        <span class="brand-word"><span class="b">Work</span><span class="g">Bridge</span></span>
        <span class="brand-sub">Personal</span>
      </span>
    </a>
    <ul class="navlinks">
      <li><a href="#leistungen" data-i18n="word.leistungen">Leistungen</a></li>
      <li><a href="#unternehmen" data-i18n="label.fuerUnternehmen">Für Unternehmen</a></li>
      <li><a href="#bewerber" data-i18n="label.fuerBewerber">Für Bewerber</a></li>
      <li><a href="#ueberuns" data-i18n="word.ueberUns">Über uns</a></li>
      <li><a href="#kontakt" data-i18n="word.kontakt">Kontakt</a></li>
    </ul>
    <div class="nav-ctas">
      <div class="langsw" role="group" aria-label="Sprache / Language / Язык">
        <button class="lang-btn" data-lang="de">DE</button>
        <button class="lang-btn" data-lang="en">EN</button>
        <button class="lang-btn" data-lang="ru">RU</button>
      </div>
      <a href="#kontakt" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" data-i18n="cta.jobFinden">Job finden</a>
      <a href="#kontakt" class="btn btn-blue btn-sm" data-i18n="cta.personalAnfragen">Auftrag anfragen</a>
      <button type="button" class="btn-apply" id="openBewerbungBtn" data-i18n="cta.bewerbungsformular">Bewerbungsformular</button>
    </div>
    <button class="navtoggle" aria-label="Menü öffnen" data-i18n-aria="a11y.menuOpen" onclick="document.getElementById('mnav').classList.toggle('open')">
      <span></span><span></span><span></span>
    </button>
  </nav>
  <div id="mnav" style="display:none; padding:0 28px 20px;">
    <ul style="list-style:none; padding:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; font-weight:500;">
      <li><a href="#leistungen" data-i18n="word.leistungen">Leistungen</a></li>
      <li><a href="#unternehmen" data-i18n="label.fuerUnternehmen">Für Unternehmen</a></li>
      <li><a href="#bewerber" data-i18n="label.fuerBewerber">Für Bewerber</a></li>
      <li><a href="#ueberuns" data-i18n="word.ueberUns">Über uns</a></li>
      <li><a href="#kontakt" data-i18n="word.kontakt">Kontakt</a></li>
    </ul>
    <div class="langsw-mobile" role="group" aria-label="Sprache / Language / Язык">
      <button class="lang-btn" data-lang="de">DE</button>
      <button class="lang-btn" data-lang="en">EN</button>
      <button class="lang-btn" data-lang="ru">RU</button>
    </div>
    <button type="button" class="btn-apply btn-apply-mobile" id="openBewerbungBtnMobile" data-i18n="cta.bewerbungsformular">Bewerbungsformular</button>
  </div>
</header>
<script>
  document.querySelector('.navtoggle').addEventListener('click', function(){
    var m = document.getElementById('mnav');
    m.style.display = m.style.display === 'none' ? 'block' : 'none';
  });
</script>

<main id="top">

  <!-- HERO -->
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="wrap hero-inner">
      <div>
        <span class="eyebrow" data-i18n="hero.eyebrow">Industrie, Logistik &amp; Produktion</span>
        <h1 style="margin-top:16px;" data-i18n-html="hero.headline">Wir <span class="grad">übernehmen</span> die Arbeit.</h1>

<script>
  document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear();

  document.getElementById('contactForm').addEventListener('submit', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    var form = this;
    var btn = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
    var errBox = document.getElementById('formErr');
    errBox.style.display = 'none';
    btn.disabled = true;
    var originalBtnText = btn.textContent;
    btn.textContent = '…';

    fetch('https://formsubmit.co/ajax/workbridgepersonal@gmail.com', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
      body: new FormData(form)
    })
      .then(function(res){ if(!res.ok) throw new Error('bad status'); return res.json(); })
      .then(function(){
        document.getElementById('formMsg').style.display = 'block';
        btn.style.display = 'none';
      })
      .catch(function(){
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = originalBtnText;
        errBox.style.display = 'block';
      });
  });

  if (!window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){ if(e.isIntersecting){ e.target.classList.add('in'); } });
    }, {threshold:0.12});
    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el){ io.observe(el); });
  } else {
    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('in'); });
  }
</script>

  function setLang(lang){
    if (!i18n[lang]) return;
    var dict = i18n[lang];
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('lang', lang);
    if (dict['meta.title']) document.title = dict['meta.title'];
    var descTag = document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]');
    if (descTag && dict['meta.desc']) descTag.setAttribute('content', dict['meta.desc']);

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(function(el){
      var key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
      if (dict[key] !== undefined) el.textContent = dict[key];
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-html]').forEach(function(el){
      var key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-html');
      if (dict[key] !== undefined) el.innerHTML = dict[key];
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-aria]').forEach(function(el){
      var key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-aria');
      if (dict[key] !== undefined) el.setAttribute('aria-label', dict[key]);
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(function(btn){
      btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.getAttribute('data-lang') === lang);
    });
    try { localStorage.setItem('wb_lang', lang); } catch(e){}
  }

  document.querySelectorAll('.lang-btn').forEach(function(btn){
    btn.addEventListener('click', function(){ setLang(btn.getAttribute('data-lang')); });
  });

  var startLang = 'de';
  try {
    var saved = localStorage.getItem('wb_lang');
    if (saved && i18n[saved]) startLang = saved;
  } catch(e){}
  setLang(startLang);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  var FRAGEBOGEN_B64 = "";
  var overlay = document.getElementById('bewerbungOverlay');
  var frame = document.getElementById('bewerbungFrame');
  var closeBtn = document.getElementById('bewerbungClose');
  var frameLoaded = false;

  function openBewerbung(){
    if (!frameLoaded) {
      frame.src = 'data:text/html;charset=utf-8;base64,' + FRAGEBOGEN_B64;
      frameLoaded = true;
    }
    overlay.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
    var mnav = document.getElementById('mnav');
    if (mnav) mnav.style.display = 'none';
  }
  function closeBewerbung(){
    overlay.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
  }

  var openBtn = document.getElementById('openBewerbungBtn');
  if (openBtn) openBtn.addEventListener('click', openBewerbung);

  var openBtnMobile = document.getElementById('openBewerbungBtnMobile');
  if (openBtnMobile) openBtnMobile.addEventListener('click', openBewerbung);

  if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeBewerbung);

  window.addEventListener('message', function(e){
    if (frame.contentWindow && e.source === frame.contentWindow && e.data && e.data.type === 'closeBewerbungOverlay') {
      closeBewerbung();
    }
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && overlay.classList.contains('open')) closeBewerbung();
  });
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
